title: Vengeance sworn
summary: Angered after slaying their brethren, the Lamanites swear vengeance upon the Nephites and do not again attempt to slay the Anti-Nephi-Lehies at that time.

explicit_facts.text: The Lamanites are more angry because they had slain their brethren, swear vengeance upon the Nephites, and do not again attempt to slay the Anti-Nephi-Lehies at that time.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Lamanite warriors gathered with weapons, expressing anger and resolve.
unspecified_visual_details: The exact place, number of warriors, clothing, weapons, and gestures.

narration.text: they swore vengeance upon the Nephites

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict an attack on the Anti-Nephi-Lehies in this scene.

title: Attack on Ammonihah
summary: The Lamanites take their armies into the borders of Zarahemla and destroy the people in the land of Ammonihah.
characters: people in the land of Ammonihah

explicit_facts.text: The Lamanites take their armies over into the borders of Zarahemla, fall upon the people in Ammonihah, and destroy them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The Lamanite army attacks people in Ammonihah.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance of the town, the size of either group, and the precise actions of the attack.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show graphic injury or add named participants.

title: Battles with the Nephites
summary: The Lamanites have many battles with the Nephites and are driven and slain. Almost all the seed of Amulon and his brethren are among those slain by Nephites.
characters: seed of Amulon and his brethren

explicit_facts.text: The Lamanites have many battles with the Nephites, in which they are driven and slain.
Almost all the seed of Amulon and his brethren who are slain are killed by the Nephites.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephite and Lamanite forces clash; Lamanites are driven back.
unspecified_visual_details: The number and identity of combatants in any single battle, battlefield, and battle tactics.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verses summarize multiple battles; this scene should not imply that all occurred at one time.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Amulon or Noah's priests as present; the passage identifies their seed and brethren.

title: Flight into the east wilderness
summary: The remainder fled into the east wilderness, usurped power and authority over the Lamanites, and caused many Lamanites to perish by fire because of their belief.

explicit_facts.text: The remainder fled into the east wilderness.
The remainder usurped power and authority over the Lamanites.
The remainder caused many Lamanites to perish by fire because of their belief.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The remainder may be shown traveling through wilderness during their flight.
unspecified_visual_details: How and when the remainder exercised authority.
Where and when the deaths by fire occurred.

narration.text: having fled into the east wilderness

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Depict only the flight. The verse does not place the deaths by fire in the east wilderness or establish that they happened during the flight.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the deaths by fire as occurring in the east wilderness.
Do not add a method of usurpation, named individuals, or dialogue.

title: Conversion in the wilderness
summary: After suffering loss and afflictions, many remember what Aaron and his brethren had preached, begin to disbelieve their fathers’ traditions and believe in the Lord, and are converted in the wilderness.

explicit_facts.text: Many had suffered much loss and many afflictions.
They began to remember words Aaron and his brethren had preached to them in their land.
They began to disbelieve their fathers’ traditions and to believe in the Lord and that he gave great power to the Nephites.
Many of them were converted in the wilderness.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A group of people in the wilderness, shown reflecting rather than hearing a new sermon.
unspecified_visual_details: How their change in belief appears visually.

narration.text: and thus there were many of them converted in the wilderness.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Aaron and his brethren’s preaching is remembered, not occurring in this scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show Aaron or his brethren preaching in the present scene.
Do not depict a supernatural manifestation or invent a conversion ritual.

title: Believers put to death
summary: The rulers who are the remnant of Amulon's children cause all those who believe these things to be put to death.
characters: rulers who were the remnant of the children of Amulon

explicit_facts.text: The rulers who are the remnant of Amulon's children cause all who believe these things to be put to death.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The rulers oversee the killing of believers.
unspecified_visual_details: The place and means of death, and how many people are present.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse summarizes the killings; it does not specify a particular execution moment.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show gore or specify a killing method.

title: Contention in the wilderness
summary: The martyrdom stirs many of the believers' brethren to anger. Contention begins in the wilderness, and the Lamanites hunt the seed of Amulon and his brethren, who flee into the east wilderness.
characters: seed of Amulon and his brethren

explicit_facts.text: The martyrdom stirs many of the believers' brethren to anger, and contention begins in the wilderness.
The Lamanites hunt and begin to slay the seed of Amulon and his brethren, who flee into the east wilderness.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Lamanites pursue members of Amulon's seed as they flee toward the east wilderness.
unspecified_visual_details: The precise location of the contention, pursuit, and killings, and whether these events occur at the same time.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: This verse summarizes a sequence; do not collapse contention, pursuit, and flight into one simultaneous event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not identify individual pursuers or fugitives.

title: The prophecy recalled
summary: The account says the seed of the priests who caused Abinadi's death are hunted at that day and recalls Abinadi's statement that what was done to him would be a type of things to come.

explicit_facts.text: The seed of the priests who caused Abinadi to suffer death by fire are hunted at that day by the Lamanites.
Abinadi said, “What ye shall do unto me shall be a type of things to come.”

reasonable_visual_inferences: The account may be presented as narration over a neutral setting.
unspecified_visual_details: The narrator and the location from which the report is made.

narration.text: What ye shall do unto me shall be a type of things to come.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Abinadi is quoted in recollection, not shown as physically present.
prohibited_inventions: Do not stage Abinadi's earlier confrontation as a present event.

title: Abinadi's death by fire recalled
summary: The account explains that Abinadi was the first to suffer death by fire because of his belief in God and that his words meant many would likewise suffer death by fire.

explicit_facts.text: Abinadi was the first to suffer death by fire because of his belief in God; the account says he meant many would suffer death by fire as he had.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A neutral narrative panel may convey this reported past without depicting it as a present action.
unspecified_visual_details: Abinadi's appearance, the location and circumstances of his death, and the people involved.

narration.text: Abinadi was the first that suffered death by fire because of his belief in God

doctrinal_or_story_notes: This verse reports prior events and explains Abinadi's meaning; do not turn it into a newly occurring scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Abinadi or a fire execution as a present visible event.

title: The priests' seed scattered
summary: The account recalls Abinadi's words to Noah's priests about their seed and says those words were verified as the seed were driven, hunted, and smitten by the Lamanites.
characters: seed of Amulon and his brethren

explicit_facts.text: Abinadi said the priests' seed would cause many to be put to death in like manner, be scattered abroad, and be slain.
The account says these words were verified: the seed were driven by the Lamanites, hunted, and smitten.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A pursuit of the seed by Lamanites is a reasonable visual representation of their being driven and hunted.
unspecified_visual_details: The particular location and timing of the pursuit, and the specific events behind the reported suffering.

narration.text: they were driven by the Lamanites

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The sheep without a shepherd is a figure of speech, not a literal scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a literal sheep or wild beasts attacking people.

title: Return and joining the people of God
summary: When the Lamanites see they cannot overpower the Nephites, they return to their own land. Many settle in Ishmael and Nephi and join the Anti-Nephi-Lehies, the people of God.

explicit_facts.text: The Lamanites return to their own land after seeing they cannot overpower the Nephites.
Many settle in the land of Ishmael and the land of Nephi and join the Anti-Nephi-Lehies, the people of God.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Newcomers join the Anti-Nephi-Lehies in one of the named lands.
unspecified_visual_details: The exact route, settlement arrangements, and which named land is shown for the joining.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: The return and later settlement are separate events within the verse; show the joining as the scene's visual moment.
prohibited_inventions: Do not combine the earlier return journey and later joining as simultaneous.

title: Weapons buried
summary: The newcomers bury their weapons of war as their brethren had and begin to be a righteous people, walking in the Lord's ways and keeping his commandments and statutes.

explicit_facts.text: They bury their weapons of war as their brethren had.
They begin to be a righteous people, walk in the Lord's ways, and observe his commandments and statutes.

reasonable_visual_inferences: People bury weapons in the ground.
unspecified_visual_details: The precise place, manner of burial, and identities of those taking part.

narration.text: they did also bury their weapons of war

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The scene depicts the explicitly reported burial; righteousness and observance are stated outcomes.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add an oath, ceremony, or specific weapon design.

title: Keeping the law and looking forward
summary: The people keep the law of Moses while looking forward in faith to Christ's coming, understanding the law as a type of his coming and relying on the spirit of prophecy for hope of eternal salvation.

explicit_facts.text: They keep the law of Moses because it is not all fulfilled and look forward to Christ's coming, believing they must keep its outward performances until he is revealed.
They do not suppose salvation comes by the law of Moses; it strengthens their faith in Christ, and they retain hope through faith unto eternal salvation, relying on the spirit of prophecy.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The passage can be conveyed through narration over a supported neutral setting.
unspecified_visual_details: The specific outward performances, people performing them, and any visible representation of Christ.

narration.text: they did keep the law of Moses
they did look forward to the coming of Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The passage describes belief and teaching, not a visible appearance of Christ.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Christ appearing or invent a specific ritual.

title: The missionaries rejoice
summary: Ammon, Aaron, Omner, Himni, and their brethren rejoice exceedingly over their success among the Lamanites and the Lord's fulfillment of his word to them.

explicit_facts.text: Ammon, Aaron, Omner, Himni, and their brethren rejoice exceedingly at their success among the Lamanites.
They see that the Lord granted according to their prayers and verified his word to them in every particular.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The named missionaries and their brethren visibly express joy together.
unspecified_visual_details: Where they are, who exactly is included among their brethren, and how their joy is expressed.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Lord is described as granting and verifying his word; no visible appearance is specified.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Lord appearing or add spoken prayer.
